description: Back office, not lifecycle-bound. Two-step product-liability disclosure flow: build a two-sided replay-challenge dossier for a disputed execution claim, then build the disclosure and rebuttal pack from the receipts in that bundle. The pack traces the receipts in the step 1 bundle; the operator is responsible for putting only in-window receipts into the claim, because art-308 does not filter receipts by disputed_window. Step 1's insufficient_evidence and bundle_claim_strength travel with the pack next to step 2's trace_digest and gap_in_window, so a pack built after step 1 reported insufficient_evidence never reads as a complete dossier. Prepared for Directive (EU) 2024/2853, transposition 9 December 2026.
name: claim-dispute-bundle-to-pld-disclosure-pack

steps.handoff: Then the step 2 run takes the step 1 output's receipts unchanged by name and builds the trace digest and rebuttal mapping from them

Then the disclosure and rebuttal pack is built from the bundle's receipts, with gap_in_window flagged when the receipt set is empty, and step 1's insufficient_evidence and bundle_claim_strength shown next to trace_digest and gap_in_window
Then the session receipts are aggregated into the session receipt

title: Claim Dispute Bundle to PLD Disclosure Pack
